mapper.select: SELECT std.DOCUMENT_ID, FNAME, MNAME, LNAME, TO_CHAR(DOB,'MM/DD/YYYY') DOB, SSN, PERSON_ADDRESS, PERSON_CITY, PERSON_STATE, PERSON_ZIP, PERSON_COUNTY, CI_REASON_PATIENT_TESTED, CI_REASON_PATIENT_TESTED_OTHR, MFA_REFSD_LNK_TO_900_OMC, MFA_REFSD_LNK_TO_900_OMC_RESN, MFA_REFSD_LNK_TO_900_OMC_OTHR, TO_CHAR(MFA_NEXT_900_RELATD_APPT_DATE,'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM') MFA_NEXT_900_RELATD_APPT_DATE, MFA_PROVIDER_NAME, MFA_CLINIC_ADDRESS, MFA_CLINIC_CITY, MFA_CLINIC_STATE, MFA_CLINIC_ZIP, MFA_CLINIC_COUNTY_FIPS, EVIDENCE_AHI_REPTD_SYMPTOMS, AHI_SYMPTOMS_REPTD_NOT_SPECFD, AHI_SYMPTOMS_ABDOMINAL_PAIN, AHI_SYMPTOMS_ARTHRALGIAS, AHI_SYMPTOMS_EXDA_PHRYNGTIS, AHI_SYMPTOMS_FATIGUE, AHI_SYMPTOMS_FEVER, AHI_SYMPTOMS_FLU_LIKE_SYMPTOM, AHI_SYMPTOMS_GENITAL_ULCERS, AHI_SYMPTOMS_HEADACHE, AHI_SYMPTOMS_LYMPHADENCPATHY, AHI_SYMPTOMS_MYALGIAS, AHI_SYMPTOMS_NAUSEA, AHI_SYMPTOMS_NIGHT_SWEATS, AHI_SYMPTOMS_ORAL_ULCERS, AHI_SYMPTOMS_PHOTOPHOBIA, AHI_SYMPTOMS_RASH, AHI_SYMPTOMS_RECTAL_ULCERS, AHI_SYMPTOMS_SORE_THROAT, AHI_SYMPTOMS_STIFF_NECK, AHI_SYMPTOMS_VOMITING, AHI_SYMPTOMS_WEIGHT_LOSS, AHI_SYMPTOMS_OTHER, EVIDENCE_AHI_PROV_DX_OF_AHI, TO_CHAR(EVIDENCE_AHI_PROV_DX_DATE,'MM/DD/YYYY') EVIDENCE_AHI_PROV_DX_DATE, AHI_SYMPTOMS_DIARRHEA, AHI_SYMPTOMS_OTHER_TEXT, FACILITY_EHARS_UID, FACILITY_ID, FACILITY_NAME, FACILITY_PHONE, FACILITY_ADDRESS, FACILITY_CITY, FACILITY_STATE, FACILITY_COUNTRY, FACILITY_ZIP, FACILITY_PLUS4, FACILITY_COUNTY, DIAGNOSIS_PROVIDER_FNAME, DIAGNOSIS_PROVIDER_MNAME, DIAGNOSIS_PROVIDER_LNAME, DIAGNOSIS_PROVIDER_SUFFIX, DIAGNOSIS_PROVIDER_NOTES, D.PARENT_DOCUMENT_ID, (SELECT AHI_FLAG from SURVEILLANCE_ASSIGNMENT where AHI_DOC_ID = #{documentId}) as AHI_FLAG FROM STD_AHI_DOC std INNER JOIN document_locator D ON (std.DOCUMENT_ID = D.document_id and std.DOCUMENT_ID=#{documentId}) LEFT OUTER JOIN person_doc_association PDOC ON (std.document_id = PDOC.document_id AND PDOC.dissassociation_date IS NULL)

select count(*) from ${tableName} acrf, STD_AHI_DOC ahi where acrf.document_id = #{acrfDocId} and ahi.document_id = #{ahiDocId}
and NVL(ahi.FNAME, 'XX') = NVL(acrf.FNAME, 'XX') and NVL(ahi.MNAME, 'XX') = NVL( acrf.MNAME, 'XX') and NVL(ahi.LNAME, 'XX') = NVL(acrf.LNAME, 'XX') and NVL(TO_CHAR(ahi.DOB, 'MM/DD/YYYY'), sysdate) = NVL(acrf.DATE_OF_BIRTH, sysdate) and NVL(ahi.PERSON_ADDRESS, 'XX') = NVL(acrf.RES_HIV_ADDRESS, 'XX') and NVL(ahi.PERSON_CITY, 'XX') = NVL(acrf.RES_HIV_CITY, 'XX') and NVL(ahi.PERSON_STATE, 'XX') = NVL(acrf.RES_HIV_STATE, 'XX') and NVL(ahi.PERSON_ZIP, 'XX') = NVL(acrf.RES_HIV_ZIPCODE, 'XX') and NVL(ahi.PERSON_COUNTY, 'XX') = NVL(acrf.RES_HIV_COUNTY_FIPS, 'XX') and NVL(ahi.FACILITY_EHARS_UID, 'XX') = NVL(acrf.FACILITY_EHARS_UID_HIV_DX, 'XX') and NVL(ahi.DIAGNOSIS_PROVIDER_FNAME, 'XX') = NVL(acrf.PROVIDER_FNAME_HIV_DX, 'XX') and NVL(ahi.DIAGNOSIS_PROVIDER_MNAME, 'XX') = NVL(acrf.PROVIDER_MNAME_HIV_DX, 'XX') and NVL(ahi.DIAGNOSIS_PROVIDER_LNAME, 'XX') = NVL(acrf.PROVIDER_LNAME_HIV_DX, 'XX') and NVL(ahi.DIAGNOSIS_PROVIDER_SUFFIX, 'XX') = NVL(acrf.PROVIDER_SUFFIX_HIV_DX, 'XX') and case when acrf.ID_TYPE_CODE = 3 then ahi.SSN else 'x' end = case when acrf.ID_TYPE_CODE = 3 then acrf.OTHER_ID_NUMBER else 'x' end

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.AHI_ALERT_SEQ_ID ahiAlertSeqId , stateno, AHI_FLAG ahiFlag, AHI_DOCUMENT_ID ahiDocId, pkg_trk_common.fn_get_fullname (usr1.last_name, usr1.first_name, usr1.middle_name, NULL) ahiFlagSetBy, to_char(AHI_CREATE_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') ahiFlagSetDate, t.AHI_ALERT_CODE alertSource, src.AHI_ALERT_DESC alertSourceDesc, PRF_COLLECTION prfCollection, AP.ANS_DESC prfCollectionDesc, to_char(PRF_COLLECTION_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') prfCollectionDate, PRF_FLAGGED_AHI prfFlaggedAhi, pkg_trk_common.fn_get_fullname (usr2.last_name, usr2.first_name, usr2.middle_name, NULL) lastUpdatedBy, to_char(t.LAST_UPDATED_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') lastUpdatedDate, pkg_trk_common.fn_get_fullname (usr3.last_name, usr3.first_name, usr3.middle_name, NULL) alertCompletedBy, to_char(ALERT_COMPLETED_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') alertCompletedDate, cf.FOLLOW_UP_CODE followupStepTakenCode, cf.FOLLOW_UP_DESC followupStepTaken, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.AHI_ALERT_SEQ_ID ORDER BY F.FOLLOW_UP_DATE DESC nulls first) rn , CASE WHEN EXISTS (select 1 from nyehms_std_message_sent a where a.stateno = t.stateno and process_ind IN ('Y', 'T')) then 'Y' else 'N' END psMsgExist, AHI_ALERT_STATUS ahiAlertStatus , to_char(AHI_ALERT_REVIEWED_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') ahiAlertReviewedDate, pkg_trk_common.fn_get_fullname (usr4.last_name, usr4.first_name, usr4.middle_name, NULL) ahiAlertReviewedBy FROM AHI_ALERT_TRACKING t, CODED_AHI_ALERT_SRC src, CODED_ACTIVE_PASSIVE ap, NYEHMS_USERS usr1, NYEHMS_USERS usr2, NYEHMS_USERS usr3, AHI_ALERT_FOLLOWUP f, CODED_AHI_PRF_FOLLOWUP cf, NYEHMS_USERS usr4 where T.AHI_ALERT_CODE = SRC.AHI_ALERT_CODE (+) and t.PRF_COLLECTION = AP.ANS_CODE (+) and t.AHI_CREATE_UID = usr1.worker_id(+) and t.LAST_UPDATED_BY = usr2.worker_id(+) and t.ALERT_COMPLETED_BY = usr3.worker_id(+) and t.AHI_ALERT_REVIEWED_BY = usr4.worker_id(+) and f.FOLLOW_UP_CODE = cf.FOLLOW_UP_CODE(+) and T.AHI_ALERT_SEQ_ID = F.AHI_ALERT_SEQ_ID(+) order by F.FOLLOW_UP_CODE ) where rn =1
select ANS_CODE, ANS_DESC from CODED_ACTIVE_PASSIVE where ANS_CODE != 'N'
select FOLLOW_UP_CODE, FOLLOW_UP_DESC from CODED_AHI_PRF_FOLLOWUP WHERE DROP_DOWN = 'Y' order by SORT_ORDER
select PS_MSG_TYPE, PS_MSG_TYPE_DESCRIPTION from CODED_PS_MSG_TYPE where END_DATE is null order by PS_MSG_TYPE_DESCRIPTION
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AHI_ALERT_FOLLOWUP (AHI_ALERT_SEQ_ID, FOLLOW_UP_CODE, USER_NOTES, FOLLOW_UP_UID, FOLLOW_UP_DATE) VALUES (#{ahiAlertSeqId}, #{followupStepTakenCode}, #{userNotes,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userNotesBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT AHI_ALERT_SEQ_ID ahiAlertSeqId, stateno, AHI_DOCUMENT_ID ahiDocId, to_char(AHI_CREATE_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') ahiFlagSetDate, USR1.FULL_NAME ahiFlagSetBy, t.AHI_ALERT_CODE alertSource, src.AHI_ALERT_DESC alertSourceDesc, AHI_FLAG ahiFlag, PRF_COLLECTION prfCollection, AP.ANS_DESC prfCollectionDesc, to_char(PRF_COLLECTION_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') prfCollectionDate, PRF_FLAGGED_AHI prfFlaggedAhi, USR2.FULL_NAME lastUpdatedBy, to_char(LAST_UPDATED_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') lastUpdatedDate, ALERT_COMPLETED_BY alertCompletedBy, to_char(ALERT_COMPLETED_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') alertCompletedDate, AHI_ALERT_STATUS ahiAlertStatus , to_char(AHI_ALERT_REVIEWED_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') ahiAlertReviewedDate, AHI_ALERT_REVIEWED_BY ahiAlertReviewedBy, (select DOCUMENT_ID from SURVEILLANCE_ASSIGNMENT where STATENO = t.STATENO and CLOSED_DATE is null and AHI_FLAG = 'Y') assignmentId, (select CASE WHEN document_type_code IN ('HIV_LAB','EPRF_OOC','ACRF','CLUSTER','PCRF','SCAN') THEN test_type_cd ELSE document_type_code END triggeringDocType from document_locator where document_id in (select TRIGGERING_DOC_ID from SURVEILLANCE_ASSIGNMENT where STATENO = '0010930066' and CLOSED_DATE is null)) triggeringDocType FROM AHI_ALERT_TRACKING t, NYEHMS_USERS_VW usr, CODED_AHI_ALERT_SRC src, CODED_ACTIVE_PASSIVE ap, NYEHMS_USERS_VW usr1, NYEHMS_USERS_VW usr2, NYEHMS_USERS_VW usr3 WHERE AHI_ALERT_SEQ_ID = #{ahiAlertSeqId} and t.AHI_CREATE_UID = usr.worker_id(+) AND T.AHI_ALERT_CODE = SRC.AHI_ALERT_CODE (+) and t.PRF_COLLECTION = AP.ANS_CODE (+) and t.AHI_CREATE_UID = usr1.worker_id(+) and t.LAST_UPDATED_BY = usr2.worker_id(+) and t.ALERT_COMPLETED_BY = usr3.worker_id(+)
